# 2D Racing Game

[中文](README.md) | English

A minimalist 2D racing game developed using HTML5 Canvas.

## Game Features

- Modern UI interface design
- Real-time speed and score display
- Life system
- Smooth racing control experience
- Game start and end screens
- Responsive design

## Controls

Use keyboard arrow keys to control the car:
- ↑ - Accelerate
- ↓ - Decelerate
- ← - Turn left
- → - Turn right

## Game Interface

- Top information bar displays:
  - Current score
  - Driving speed
  - Remaining lives
- Main game canvas
- Bottom control instructions
- Game over popup
- Start game screen

## Tech Stack

- HTML5 Canvas - Game rendering
- CSS3 - Modern interface styling
- JavaScript - Game logic
- Font Awesome - Icon library
- Custom fonts - Display optimization

## Project Structure

```
├── index.html    # Main game page
├── style.css     # Stylesheet
├── game.js       # Game logic
└── fonts.css     # Font styles
```

## Development Features

- Modern gradient background
- Carefully designed user interface
- Responsive layout
- Smooth animation effects
- Intuitive game controls

## Installation and Running

1. Clone or download the project code
2. Open index.html with a modern browser
3. Start enjoying the game!

## Browser Support

- Chrome (recommended)
- Firefox
- Safari
- Edge

Supports all modern browsers, latest versions recommended for the best gaming experience.
